In the process of image formation, the distance from an object to the lens is called the object distance P and the distance of the image from the lens is called the image distance q. The relationship between p, q and f is

1/p + 1/q = 1/f

If a lens is used to form an image of a very distant object, then the object distance p is very large. For that case, the term 1/p in Equation 2 is negligible compared to the other terms 1/q and 1/f in that equation. Thus, for the case of a very distant object, Equation 2 becomes

1/q = 1/f

If two lenses with focal lengths f_1 and f_2 are placed in contact, the combination of the two in contact acts as a single lens of effective focal length f related to the individual focal lengths of the two lenses in contact, f_1 and f_2 by

1/f = 1/f_1 + 1/f_2

An experiment was conducted to investigate the properties of converging and diverging lenses, using three lenses, A, B, and C. Below was the experimental procedure taken.

Step 1: One of the three lenses, A, was placed in the lens holder on the optical bench. A screen was mounted toward the same distance from the lens. The object placed was the lens holder in front of the window branch. A laboratory printed on a bench distant object. The distance from the lens to the screen was adjusted until a sharp, real image of the distant object formed on screen. The measured image distance was 19.5 cm. The same procedure was used for lens B and lens C. The measured image distances for lens B and lens C can be obtained from your group/Class C.

Step 2: For each object placed, the lens holder was moved with the object painted on to face the screen. For each value of p, the image distance q from the lens to the screen was located until a sharp real image is formed on the screen. For various values of p, the image distance q were determined. Data Table 1 shows the results obtained. Four values for p = 10, 20, 30, and 40 cm, the respective values of q was determined. Data Table 1 shows the results obtained. Four values for p and image distance p and q.

The focal length of the combination f_c was then measured both by the very distant object method and by the object two-lens method.
